how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each referral gives a Small Block prize ticket for the current block, and more referrals provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block provides recurring $500 prizes, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and paid to the winner wallet.
